summary: Master the art of Stress Testing in Credit Risk Management. Join our training course to gain essential insights and tools for effective risk assessment.
lede: Stress testing in credit risk management gives you a structured way to design adverse scenarios, apply stressed PD, LGD, and EAD assumptions, and assess how portfolios may respond. This course helps you segment portfolios, examine concentrations, summarize capital impacts, and interpret results with greater consistency. You will build a defensible workflow for analysis and management reporting, including governance concepts, validation checkpoints, and practical reporting templates. Using spreadsheet-based exercises and board-ready outputs, you will learn to communicate credible findings despite data limitations, reporting deadlines, and model governance scrutiny.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with credit portfolios, macroeconomic scenarios, model assumptions, and risk reporting. It suits people who need to turn stress testing in credit risk management into actionable outputs for committees, boards, regulators, and internal governance forums.
modules: PD, LGD, and EAD Under Stress
prerequisites: You will need a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a working familiarity with credit risk terminology. A basic understanding of portfolio data, macroeconomic variables, and reporting workflows will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
